title: Tokyo vs Taipei: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Tokyo and Taipei based on Reddit discussions, real costs, weather data, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 🍜 Food & Dining
categories.summary: This is genuinely the closest category in the entire comparison — and also the most subjective. faqs.question: Is Tokyo or Taipei better for first-time visitors to Asia?
faqs.answer: Both are excellent first-timer cities, but they serve different travelers. Tokyo overwhelms in the best possible way — the sheer scale, variety of food, and transit efficiency are hard to match. Taipei is smaller, cheaper, warmer in personality, and easier to navigate without Japanese. Reddit consen

faqs.question: Is Taipei much cheaper than Tokyo?
faqs.answer: Significantly cheaper, yes. A mid-range day in Taipei runs NT$1,800–3,000 ($55–95 USD). The same in Tokyo costs ¥12,000–18,000 ($80–120 USD). faqs.question: How far apart are Tokyo and Taipei?
faqs.answer: About 2,100 km by air. Flights take 3–3.5 hours. Budget carriers like Tigerair Taiwan and Peach fly the route frequently from Narita/Haneda to Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). Fares can be as low as ¥15,000 ($100) one way if you book early. This makes Tokyo + Taipei a very doable two-destination

faqs.question: Which city has better food — Tokyo or Taipei?
faqs.answer: This is genuinely the hardest call in this comparison. Tokyo has more Michelin stars than any city on Earth and covers every cuisine imaginable. Taipei has one of the world's best street food cultures, the finest beef noodle soup you'll ever eat, and night markets that run until 2am. Reddit traveler

faqs.question: Is it worth combining Tokyo and Taipei in one trip?
faqs.answer: Absolutely, and it's more popular than people expect. With 10–14 days, a Tokyo → Taipei (or reverse) route works beautifully. faqs.question: Which city is safer — Tokyo or Taipei?
faqs.answer: Both are among the safest cities in the world for tourists. Tokyo's crime rate is extraordinarily low — lost wallets get turned in, and solo female travelers regularly report feeling completely safe at midnight. faqs.question: How many days do I need in Tokyo vs Taipei?
faqs.answer: Tokyo needs at least 4 full days for a first visit — ideally 5–6. It's massive, and underestimating it is the most common tourist mistake. faqs.question: Which city has better nightlife?
faqs.answer: Tokyo, and it's not close for sheer variety. Shinjuku's Golden Gai, Shibuya's clubs, Shimokitazawa's jazz bars, Roppongi's international scene — Tokyo runs 24 hours and has something for every taste and budget.
